title: Academic and Clinical Productivity - a Needs Assessment in the Context of Mental Health Research
summary:
The following study will use an online survey of members of German research insitutions researching mental health to determine the frequency of groups with different forms of diversity (gender, LGBTIQ* status, age, health/ability, non-academic background, education, religion, regional background, migration or ethnicity, care or nursing work) at different career stages.

In addition, possible positive and negative influences on the productivity and well-being of groups that are socially disadvantaged will be investigated. Subsequently, possible starting points for the development of a support system for socially disadvantaged groups inside German resarch institutions will be identified. The groups that tend to be socially disadvantaged  will always be compared with groups that have a good level of social inclusion.
